thread:
maya: Quick preflight for the pricing rollout tomorrow morning. Need a concise list of implementation blockers across metering, billing, quotas, and contract constraints. Who's owning what?

raj: Quick Q — are quota checks already wired into the feature-flag path? I saw a missing tag on service-metrics earlier. @sam any updates on that? :eyes:

sam: I can take metering ownership. Need the final SKU -> meter_id mapping to finish emitter and e2e tests. maya can you confirm the mapping?

maya: Putting the short mapping here (full doc in /docs/pricing-rollout):
```json
{"SKU_BASIC":"meter_basic_monthly","SKU_PRO":"meter_pro_monthly","SKU_API":"meter_api_unit"}
```

courtney: Billing note: invoice grouping changes with the new packaging. We need to confirm whether to preserve "prepaid" vs "postpay" flags per contract — legal flagged rounding rules for pro-rated months. Blocking if unresolved.

eli: Migration concern: active subscriptions need a safe path to avoid double-billing when meter ids change. Recommend canary by customer tier (start with trial & SMB).

sam: Implementation detail: emitter will send event type `usage_v2`. Example payload we plan to emit: 
```json
{"event":"usage_v2","meter_id":"meter_pro_monthly","units":1,"customer_id":"cust_123","ts":"2024-11-01T14:22:00Z"}
```

raj: Quota enforcement flow: client -> nginx sidecar -> rate-limiter -> service. On reject we return 429 with X-Quota-Reset header. I'll add integration tests against the sidecar. Snippet for header: `X-Quota-Reset: 1698768000`

maya: Owners (proposed): sam = metering/emitter + tests, raj = quota enforcement + infra tests, courtney = billing mapping & invoice grouping, eli = migration/canary plan. Can everyone ack and call out any known blockers by EOD? :white_check_mark:

courtney: Ack. Blocking: need final contract clause text for rollover and proration by 10:00 PST tomorrow, otherwise billing mapping freeze will block release.

sam: Ack. I need ~6 hours to finish emitter and e2e. Will push branch `metering/pricing-rollout` and open a PR. Command I'll use: `git push origin metering/pricing-rollout`

raj: Ack. I'll add integration tests and coordinate with infra to reserve burst capacity during rollout window.

billing-bot: billing-bot: queued invoice-schema migration job id=job_8843 status=pending

maya: Thanks all. If anything blocks the timeline ping #incidents and @maya directly. I'll consolidate any changes into the rollout checklist. :thumbsup:
